Teste glicemie bandelete reactive compatibile cu glucometrul Accu-Chek Active + 25 ace gratis. Se ofera gratuit un APARAT DE GLICEMIE la fiecare 20 cutii achizitiontate. Termen de valabilitate : 12-16 luni de la data achizitionarii. -mod de ambalare: 50 teste pe cutie -continutul pachetului: flacon cu 50 teste, 1 CIP de calibrare, instructiuni de utilizare -metoda de masurare: fotometrica -tip de proba utilizata: sange capilar proaspat, sange total venos si arterial heparinizat sau recoltat pe EDTA, sange recoltat de la nou nascuti; proba poate fi recoltata din deget sau din zone alternative -volum proba: 1,5 µl sange -timp de masurare: 5 secunde -interval de masurare: 10-600 mg/dl -posibilitatea confirmarii vizuale: pentru verificare suplimentara – o scala de culori intre 30 si 800 mg/dl tiparita pe eticheta flaconului de teste -continutul pachetului: flacon cu 50 teste, 1 CIP de calibrare, instructiuni de utilizare.

The project intends to explore how women´s voices and needs could be better captured and addressed by the social protection programs and various stakeholder of the social protection system. A situational analysis which also provides recommendations for improvement is being finalized. Policy development and implementation support will be provided by the project to advance the recommendations outlined in this report. Work package 2 (Experts Pool 2): Universal Health Coverage (UHC) (part of output 3 or 4 of the project) ISPH II requires experts to support the advisory services related to following areas: - In the overall health sector reform agenda, the National Payment and Certification Agency (NPCA) is a central actor as it is tasked with claims processing for the 2 national social health protection schemes. The project provides policy advice to NPCA on its key processes, i.e. claims management and the verification of quality assessments of health care providers. In addition, the project will support NPCA in its task to explore and propose strategic purchasing related improvements based on intelligence gained from its claims processing business and data. - The project also supports MoH on improving the quality of health services provision through strengthening human resources development for health. Concretely, the project provides technical assistance to MoH on the development of a national accreditation system for newly updated health training programmes. At the training service provider level, the project supports three training institutions to further institutionalise competency-based training. The supported activities include faculty development, implementation of clinical based teaching tools, etc. Work package 3 (Experts Pool 3): Digitalisation, Research, and Organisational Development (part of output 1, 2, 3 or 4 of the project) Work Package 3 entails three cross-cutting topics which are relevant for both USP and UHC. - Digitalisation efforts of ISPH II are grounded on the Digital Social Protection Strategy 2024 - 2028 which was adopted by the NSPC in March 2024. ISPH II supports the GS-NSPC as the policy coordinator to drive the strategy\\\"s implementation. Focus will be primarily on capacity development, strengthening policy and legal frameworks and strengthening stakeholder coordination.
